input.quote: (c) In the event of termination under either section 6(a) or 6(b) of this agreement, Contractor shall be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination. Upon receipt of final payment Contractor shall provide to Company, and will assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Section 6 (with the related clause (c) at p0044) addresses only notice, final fees and assignment of Works in progress. There is no obligation on Contractor to provide transition assistance, to return Company data/Confidential Information in a usable format, or to delete and certify deletion afterwards; Section 8 restricts use/disclosure of Confidential Information but requires no return or destruction. This is a services/development engagement where our data and work product sit with Contractor, so the playbook's exit protections are absent and inserted as new Section 6(d) (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion), carved back for Contractor's Information under Section 4(b).

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in Section 6
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard exit clause: on expiry or termination Contractor provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data, Works and Confidential Information within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and then deletes and certifies deletion. The Agreement is otherwise silent on exit, which would leave our data and in-flight work stranded; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Company data and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such Works, Company data and Confidential Information from its systems (other than Contractor's Information as described in Section 4(b)) and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
